name: Blackstone Inc.

R1.just: Fee-based alt-management scales (FRE margin ~57-58%, FRE/sh +23% Q1'26), but capital-light is not a pure software/network margin-amplifier, so no 1.5/2.0.

R2.just: Durable secular tailwind into alternatives: record AUM $1.30T, $68.5B Q1 inflows, structural shift of institutional+retail capital into private markets.

R3.just: Clear #1 global alternative-asset manager by AUM ($1.30T), ahead of KKR/Apollo/Ares/Blue Owl, but leadership gap is strong not light-years-monstrous.

R4.just: Strong moat from brand, track record, LP relationships, scale and high switching costs (locked-up multi-year fund capital); durable but not irreplicable-over-decades.

R5.just: Growth is overwhelmingly organic (inflows/deployment, DE +25%, FRE +23%) rather than M&A-driven, a genuine strength.

R6.just: Highly diversified across PE, real estate, credit/insurance, hedge-fund solutions and infrastructure with multi-geography LPs and no single-client concentration.

R7.just: Capital-light, high-margin, strong FCF (~$4.55B, ~31% margin), but DE/FRE returns are sensitive to realizations and performance fees, so solid not exceptional.

R8.just: Investment-grade A+ with low corporate leverage (~$9.8B net debt, ~1.2x ND/EBITDA, consolidated incl. fund/CLO items); sound but not net-cash.

R9.just: HARD RULE: verified equity-based comp FY2025 $1,445M = 31.8% of FCF (>25%), up +24% YoY, plus large separate carry comp; forces R9=0.0.

R10.just: Founder-led (Schwarzman), heavy insider skin-in-the-game, disciplined capital allocation, growing dividend; strong governance though dual-class caps the top score.

amplification_note: R3 (#1 alt-manager at $1.30T AUM), R4 (brand + locked-up-capital switching costs + track-record moat) and R2/R1 (scalable fee engine riding the secular private-markets shift) reinforce each other into a fundraising flywheel: scale begets credibility, which deepens the moat and compounds AUM/fees. Genuine self-reinforcing dynamic, hence amplification=true, though short of monstrous winner-take-all network dominance.
moat_one_line: Scale, brand and multi-year locked-up LP capital create high switching costs and a self-reinforcing fundraising flywheel atop the world's largest alternative-asset platform.
thesis_3lines: CALIDAD: #1 global alternative-asset manager ($1.30T AUM, A+ rated, capital-light ~31% FCF margin) with a durable brand/track-record/locked-up-capital moat, though high SBC (31.8% of FCF) is a real accounting blemish.

MOTOR: Secular shift of institutional and retail capital into private markets drives organic compounding (DE +25%, FRE +23%, $68.5B Q1 inflows) into digital/AI/energy infrastructure, partly offset by private-credit redemption pressure and slower realizations.

VALORACION: Fwd P/E ~19.8x sits ~21% below its multi-year average after a ~35% drop from the 52w high, a mostly fear-driven de-rating offering an attractive entry on strong-but-decelerating fundamentals.
bear_case_strongest: If the credit cycle turns, the 2026 private-credit redemption scare (BCRED outflows, sector-wide withdrawal caps) becomes structural, collapsing realizations, fundraising and performance fees on an inherently cyclical earnings base whose equity comp keeps climbing, so today's "fear discount" may be correctly-priced deterioration rather than opportunity.
notes: FASE 2 re-score. Total ponderado = 1.0+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.0+1.0+0.0+1.5 = 12.0/13.5 (FASE 1 preliminar fue 13.5/13.5). Cambio clave: R9=0.0 por REGLA DURA de SBC, equity-based comp verificada FY2025 $1,445.4M = 31.8% del FCF (>25%), +24% YoY, mas carry comp separada. Resto solido (lider, moat, organico, diversificado) pero sin 2.0 porque la dominancia no es monstruosa/irreplicable ni el modelo amplifica margenes como software/red. Q1'26 fuerte (DE +25%, FRE +23%, AUM record $1.30T) pero desacelerando; de-rating ~-35% predominantemente miedo/rotacion por susto de redenciones en credito privado (BCRED/Partners Group), MIXED. Fwd P/E ~19.8x (~-21% vs media), direccionalmente barata. Hard data VERIFICADO via SEC 10-K XBRL e IR; precio/multiplos/ND ESTIMADOS.
